_meta.purpose: Tools, models, services and asset sources that must NOT be used to produce anything that ships, or must not be bundled into the runtime. The licence-audit check fails if a manifest row, a ComfyUI workflow, a dependency or a prompt log references an entry here.
_meta.source: docs/research/stack-final.md (decision log and per-stage 'Excluded' lines) plus the stage deep-dives.

categoryValues.policy: The vendor's usage policy prohibits this use (e.g. real-money gambling).
categoryValues.licence: Non-commercial, territory-restricted, revenue-capped or unstated licence.
categoryValues.availability: No usable API, shut down, or exports disabled.
categoryValues.engineering: Wrong format/version or unsafe to automate; not a legal problem.

_meta.unblock: Entries with an 'unblockIf' value can move to allowlist.json once that condition is met and the evidence PDF is filed in licenses/clearances/.

entries.name: OpenAI GPT Image 2 / 2.5 (Sunburst, Flare) / gpt-image-1.5, on any platform
entries.reason: OpenAI Usage Policies (effective 2025-10-29) list 'real money gambling' as a prohibited use; the Commerce Policies also bar gambling services. The policy follows the model through every reseller: Higgsfield (gpt_image_2, gpt_image_2_5), fal, Replicate, Layer and Scenario.
entries.unblockIf: Written confirmation from OpenAI that producing art for a licensed real-money slot is permitted.
entries.alternative: vertex-nano-banana-pro + toonout/birefnet matting; ideogram-v3-api for native alpha after clearance.

entries.name: GPT-6 Astra via Codex CLI or API (the 'ChatGPT Astra' co-orchestrator / reviewer)
entries.reason: Same OpenAI real-money-gambling prohibition. It is kept out of the build, the art and the review loop until cleared.
entries.unblockIf: Written OpenAI clearance. It can then join as a blind second judge through Codex CLI (MCP via config.toml).

entries.name: Sora 2
entries.reason: The OpenAI Sora 2 API shuts down on 2026-09-24 and is absent from the Higgsfield CLI catalog. The OpenAI gambling policy also applies.
entries.alternative: Blender renders from the real rigs; Higgsfield seedance/kling for animatics only.

entries.name: ChatGPT Atlas browser agent
entries.reason: Reportedly shut down on 2026-08-09 (secondary sources only). The OpenAI gambling policy would apply regardless.
entries.alternative: Claude in Chrome (claude --chrome) on your own Mac/Windows machine for web-only steps.

entries.name: Midjourney (any version)
entries.reason: No official API, and its Terms prohibit automated tools. The Disney/Universal litigation adds IP-provenance risk. It may be used for human moodboarding only; nothing from it ships or trains.

entries.name: Tencent Hunyuan family: HunyuanImage 3.0, Hunyuan3D 2.x/3.x, HY-Motion 1.0, HunyuanVideo-Foley
entries.reason: The licences 'DO NOT APPLY IN THE EUROPEAN UNION, UNITED KINGDOM AND SOUTH KOREA', and outputs may not be used outside that territory. That is incompatible with an international EU/UK product. Disable the Hunyuan3D tool in mcp-for-blender.
entries.alternative: tripo / meshy / hyper3d-rodin for meshes; qwen-image-* for images.

entries.name: Self-hosted FLUX.1 [dev], FLUX.1 Fill [dev], FLUX.2 [dev], FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
entries.reason: FLUX Non-Commercial licence. Production or revenue use of the model needs a BFL commercial licence. Never use these as a LoRA base.
entries.unblockIf: A purchased BFL self-hosted commercial licence.

entries.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (native RGBA, 2026-09-20)
entries.reason: Qwen Research licence (non-commercial).

entries.name: Ideogram 4.0 open weights
entries.reason: The weights are under a non-commercial model agreement. Only the code is Apache-2.0.

entries.name: BRIA RMBG-2.0 self-hosted, including rembg's DEFAULT model (bria-rmbg)
entries.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial without a paid BRIA agreement. rembg picks it silently when no -m flag is given.
entries.alternative: toonout, lucida, birefnet-rembg with an explicit -m birefnet-general.

entries.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2 default install
entries.reason: Code and weights are MIT, but the texture pipeline depends on nvdiffrast/nvdiffrec, which are under NVIDIA non-commercial source licences. R&D only.

entries.name: MatAnyone / MatAnyone 2, VideoMaMa, SAM2Matting, TransPixeler
entries.reason: MatAnyone: NTU S-Lab 1.0 (non-commercial). VideoMaMa: CC BY-NC 4.0. SAM2Matting: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. TransPixeler: Adobe Research licence (non-commercial).
entries.alternative: sam3/sam2.1 tracked mask + birefnet-rembg per frame, or wan-alpha-2.

entries.name: Meta AudioCraft (MusicGen, AudioGen) weights, MMAudio
entries.reason: Weights and checkpoints are CC BY-NC 4.0.

entries.name: Suno
entries.reason: No public API (partner programme is application-only), and unofficial wrappers violate its ToS. Suno reportedly retains underlying ownership (secondary source). Unsuitable for a regulated product.

entries.name: Udio
entries.reason: Walled garden with exports disabled since the UMG settlement.

entries.name: ACE-Step (for SHIPPED cues)
entries.reason: The code is MIT/Apache, but its training-data provenance is undisclosed and its README warns of stylistic-similarity infringement. That is a reputational and legal risk for a regulated gambling product. Local sketches are fine; nothing from it ships.

entries.name: Stable Audio 3 open weights (above USD 1M annual revenue)
entries.reason: The Stability AI Community License terminates above $1M annual revenue; an Enterprise licence is then required.
entries.unblockIf: Stability Enterprise licence, or revenue below the threshold (confirm with counsel).

entries.name: Higgsfield audio models (mirelo_text_to_audio, sonilo_music)
entries.reason: Terms for these third-party audio models are unknown. They may be used for drafts only, until cleared.
entries.unblockIf: Written terms from Higgsfield covering these models for commercial real-money use.

entries.name: See-through (shitagaki-lab) layer decomposition weights
entries.reason: The code is Apache-2.0, but no licence is stated for the model files, and the training data is 9,102 scraped Live2D models. Keep it out of any path that writes to art/source.

entries.name: GenielabsOpenSource/spine-animation-ai
entries.reason: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Reimplement the idea; do not copy the code.

entries.name: All community Spine MCPs (e.g. nihatcagri44/spine-motion-mcp, egorfedorov/spine-mcp, ampersante/spine2d-animation-mcp, K-ulucay/spine_anim_mcp, 1425sd/spine-MCP, neko233-com/spine233-agent-cli)
entries.reason: They target the Spine 4.2/3.8 formats. A 4.2-format file loads in 4.3 with every constraint silently dropped. One README shows a cracked Spine build, one reverse-engineers the .spine binary, and one is PolyForm-NC. There is no official Spine MCP.
entries.alternative: Official Spine CLI wrapped by committed scripts.

entries.name: Legacy rodin-api-mcp and blender-mcp's Rodin 'Sketch' tier
entries.reason: Superseded by the official rodin3d-skills plugin (Gen-2.5).

entries.name: MoMask / MotionGPT-family text-to-motion
entries.reason: The code is MIT, but the SMPL/SMPL-X and HumanML3D licences may restrict commercial use.
entries.alternative: Claude-written anim JSON + Blender; uthana for bipeds.

entries.name: Mixamo
entries.reason: No API, so it only works through a browser agent (T3), and its Adobe terms were unverified. Not in the automated path.
entries.alternative: Claude-written anim JSON; Meshy/Tripo presets as a seed.

entries.name: Houdini Indie / Apprentice
entries.reason: Indie is void above $100k revenue; Apprentice is non-commercial.

entries.name: JangaFX EmberGen / IlluGen / LiquiGen, Cascadeur
entries.reason: GUI-only (T3/T4), so they stay out of the automated path. A human may use them if art review demands, after checking their revenue-tier EULA.
entries.alternative: Blender headless flipbooks; Claude-written anim JSON.

entries.name: @theatre/studio
entries.reason: AGPL-3.0. Never bundle it into the game.

entries.name: @pixi/particle-emitter 5.x / pixi-particles 4.x
entries.reason: Pixi below v8 only.

entries.name: PyPI 'triangle' (bundles Shewchuk's Triangle)
entries.reason: Its C licence allows distribution in commercial systems only by direct arrangement with the author.

entries.name: Stake web-sdk sample backgrounds, symbols, animations and Spine files
entries.reason: Stake's frontend requirements say sample assets will NOT be approved; every audio and visual asset must be unique.

entries.name: npm 'stake-engine' (engineio/ts-client) in the shipped build
entries.reason: It console.logs its version (the approval team checks for logging) and has no replay support.

entries.name: Any runtime request to a host other than the page origin and rgs_url: Google Fonts, Typekit, analytics/Sentry, hot-linked vendor output URLs (Higgsfield, Scenario, etc.), default KTX2/Basis transcoder CDN paths
entries.reason: Stake enforces a strict XSS policy: the build must be static files and 'All images and fonts must be loaded from the Stake Engine CDN'. Pixi and three default their KTX2/Basis transcoder paths to a public CDN.
entries.alternative: Bundle everything; copy the transcoders into public/ and point the setters at relative paths. tools/qa/approval.mjs enforces the host allowlist.
